Account.title: Access tokens
Account.intro: Tokens let the CLI and API clients act as {username} with your permissions. Send one as {header}. A token is shown only once; regenerate it if you lose it.
Account.credentialsIntro: Your own secrets for the Runs you own, such as the token the agent signs in with. They are stored encrypted, never shown again, and used instead of the server's value; without one the server's value applies.

Access.needsPermission: Managing users and roles needs the global write permission.
Access.title: Users & roles
Access.intro: A role is a set of permissions: read (see everything in a Project) and write (do actions with everything; includes read). Assign roles globally or per Project; a user holds a permission if any of their roles grants it. Managing users and roles needs a global write.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.intro: Group repositories. Use the top bar to switch your working scope.
Projects.promptAdditionHint: Appended to every Automation and Ad-hoc prompt for this Project's Repositories.
Projects.configIntro: Blank settings inherit the global value, including later global changes. Overrides apply to this Project's Repositories for work started after saving.
Projects.belongsToOne: A repository belongs to at most one Project; saving moves it from its previous Project.
Projects.deleteMessage: Delete {name}? Its repositories become unassigned; no Automations or Runs are removed.

AgentSettings.intro: How is prompt behavior configured for each Repository and Workflow?
AgentSettings.deleteNone: Delete Agent "{name}"? It is not assigned anywhere.

AgentSettings.name: Name
AgentSettings.emptyInstructionsHint: Empty: Runs that resolve to this Agent are blocked.
AgentSettings.additionalInstructionsPlaceholder: Anything the Agent should also cover or keep in mind

AgentSettings.allowAllHint: Copilot only. When unchecked, only the allowed tools below are permitted.
AgentSettings.allowedToolsHint: One Copilot tool pattern per line.
AgentSettings.blockedToolsHint: One Copilot tool pattern per line, added to the global runs.denyTools, which always applies.
AgentSettings.templateHint: Shared by every Repository and Agent for this Workflow. Blank means none.
AgentSettings.assignmentsSaveNote: Assignment changes save immediately. Save the operation template separately.
AgentSettings.agentsIntro: Agents are instruction-only profiles and can be assigned to any Workflow.
AgentSettings.assignmentsIntro: Each Workflow uses its Repository Agent if one is set, otherwise the default. A slot with no Agent, or an Agent with empty instructions, blocks Runs before Copilot starts.
